stock.description: Knowledge Atlas Technology Joint Stock Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engaged in the provision of large model-related services in the People's Republic of china. It operates through two segments: On-premise deployment, and Cloud-based deployment. The On-Premise Deployment Segment develops and provides customised large model-related services according to the customers' specific instructions, and needs at the customers infrastructure; and other related services such as model training and fine-tuning. The Cloud-Based Deployment Segment develops, and provides subscription-based service, usage based service, and other related services such as model training and fine-tuning through cloud infrastructure. The company offers z.ai, AutoGLM, AutoClaw, ChatGLM, Zread.ai, and AMiner. The company serves institutional customers, including private enterprises and public sector entities, as well as individual users, including individual end-users and individual developers; as well as companies, research organizations, and government agencies. The company was formerly known as Beijing Zhipu Huazhang Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Knowledge Atlas Technology Joint Stock Company Limited. Knowledge Atlas Technology Joint Stock Company Limited was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
